comment: Capacity design uses a nontrivial bridge bottleneck at 7->8 (finite) rather than the globally smallest edge. Edge 3->4 has the smallest capacity but is not the min-cut driver. Includes one Inf edge (3->5) to exercise parser and mixed finite/infinite capacities. Several <=3 edges are expected to saturate under optimum flow, creating meaningful sensitivity/Birnbaum/threshold variation.
